column2: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
By David. Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.
Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.
Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.”
For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.
but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.”
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
“You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.”
But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.”
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.”
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.
“As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.”
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
Let all that you do be done in love.
for we walk by faith, not by sight.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
Always rejoice.
In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
We love him, because he first loved us.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.
